heading: Requirement for prisons located in United States to provide information for tax administration

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Not later than September 15, 2012, and annually thereafter, the head of the Federal Bureau of Prisons and the head of any State agency charged with the responsibility for administration of prisons shall provide to the Secretary in electronic format a list with the information described in subsection (b) of all the inmates incarcerated within the prison system for any part of the prior 2 calendar years or the current calendar year through August 31.

tree.heading: Information
tree.text: The information with respect to each inmate is—

children.text: institution of current incarceration or, for released inmates, most recent incarceration,
the date of release or anticipated date of release,
taxpayer identification number and whether the prison has verified such number,
any additional information as the Secretary may request.

tree.heading: Format
tree.text: The Secretary shall determine the electronic format of the information described in subsection (b).

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 6116 was renumbered section 6117 of this title.
